scanners.title: pull request trivy scanners
scanners.description: The Trivy scanners run on the pull request with the `trivy fs` command

severity.title: pull request trivy severity
severity.description: The minimum severities reported by the Trivy scans, as a comma separated list

ignore-file.title: pull request trivy ignore file
ignore-file.description: The path of the Trivy ignore file in the repository, the `--ignorefile` argument is added only if the file exists

config-targets.title: pull request trivy config targets
config-targets.description: The files scanned with the `trivy config` command, the command is run only for the files that exist in the repository
